---
title: "simstim cp"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Copy files or folders into or out of a session over SFTP.

```text
simstim cp <source> <destination> [flags]
```

Copies a file or folder between this machine and a session's workspace over SFTP. Name the remote side as &lt;host&gt;/&lt;session&gt;:&lt;path&gt;. A relative path starts in the session's workspace. Writes on this machine stay inside os.Root without following symbolic links, and files that can run code are flagged for review.

## Examples

```sh
simstim cp my-vps/auth-fix:notes.md .
simstim cp ./data.csv my-vps/auth-fix:data.csv
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-flagged` | copy files that can run code or contain hidden text without asking |
| `-f`, `--force` | replace existing files at the destination |
| `-r`, `--recursive` | copy folders recursively (already the default) |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |
